payload.name: Preserve All Stated Reasons in Preference Extraction
payload.description: When extracting a profile or preference memory from a statement that lists multiple reasons or attributes for a choice, include every explicitly stated reason; do not drop any stated motivation.
content: During candidate extraction, if a speaker gives multiple explicit reasons for liking, choosing, or preferring something, capture all of those reasons in the candidate content.
Do not summarize away any stated reason even if one seems more salient; later questions may depend on any single stated reason.

solves: During construction extraction, a profile or preference memory sometimes keeps only a subset of explicitly stated reasons for a choice, leaving later answers incomplete. This rule applies whenever a single message gives multiple reasons or attributes for a person's preference or choice; it instructs the extractor to preserve all explicit reasons instead of selecting a subset.
